📋 About Bizora

Bizora is a smart business management platform built to help small and growing businesses take control of their daily operations with confidence. It brings your cash sales, credit sales, customer records, and inventory into one offline-first tool — so you always know exactly where your business stands, down to the last franc.

The name says it all — Bizora is built on five principles:

B·I
Business
Intelligence
Z
Zero
Loss
O
Organization

Records

Analytics

Together, these turn everyday transactions into real business intelligence — helping you organize your records, plug the small leaks that quietly drain profit, and make sharper decisions backed by real numbers, not guesswork. No internet connection, no subscription, no data leaving your device — ever.

💡 Our Mission

Our mission is simple: empower businesses to operate efficiently, make informed decisions, and grow sustainably through intelligent, easy-to-use technology.

Every unrecorded sale, forgotten debt, and untracked stock item is money quietly walking out the door. Bizora puts a stop to that — giving you the same visibility and control that larger businesses pay thousands for, in one tool you own outright and run entirely on your own terms.

Help Center

Everything you need to run Bizora with confidence

🚀 Quick Start Guide
  1. Set up your business profile in Settings — name, currency, contact info.
  2. Add your first products under Inventory, or your first customer under Customers.
  3. Record a cash sale from the POS screen, or a credit sale from Sales.
  4. Track what customers owe you on the Ledger page, and record payments as they come in.
  5. Check your Dashboard and Financial Summary anytime to see how the business is doing.
💡 Tips & Best Practices
  • Record every sale the moment it happens — Bizora works fully offline, so there's never a reason to "record it later".
  • Export a backup regularly from Backup — weekly is a good habit, especially before a phone update.
  • Set low-stock thresholds on your products so Bizora warns you before you run out.
  • Use Employee Access Control if you have staff, so each person only sees what their role needs.
💾 Backup & Restore Guide

To back up: go to Backup, tap "Export Backup" — this downloads a single JSON file with all your data. Store a copy somewhere safe (email it to yourself, save to cloud storage).

To restore: go to Backup, tap "Import Backup" and select your file. Bizora checks the file first and warns you before importing anything — your existing data is never overwritten, only added to.

🔑 License & Activation Help

Bizora starts with a 30-day free trial — no card, no signup. When you're ready, tap "Purchase Now" in Settings to buy a license.

After payment, you'll receive a license key. Paste it into the activation box in Settings — activation works completely offline once you have the key. If a key ever shows as "invalid or tampered," contact support below rather than trying a modified copy.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Does Bizora need internet to work?

No. Every core feature — sales, inventory, customers, reports — works fully offline. Internet is only used for the optional purchase/renewal checkout link and WhatsApp support.

What happens to my data if I lose my phone?

Your data lives on that device only, so a regular backup export (saved elsewhere) is the only way to recover it on a new device. See the Backup & Restore guide above.

Can I use Bizora on more than one device?

Each license activates on one device at a time. Contact support if you need to move your license to a new phone.

Will updates delete my data?

No. Updates only replace app code — your sales, customers, and inventory always stay on your device untouched.

Need more help? Reach out via the contact details on the About page.
